title: Best Sales Copywriters (2026): How to Hire One That Sells
description: How to hire a sales copywriter: what the package should include, how to brief it, what drives the price and the red flags to avoid.
intro: Sales copy is the text on sales pages, product pages and emails that persuades people to buy. Good copy is built on what customers actually want and worry about. It fails when the brief is thin, when the writer copies competitors, or when claims go further than the product can deliver. This guide shows you how to brief copy that sells honestly.

faq.q: What is the difference between sales copy and content writing?
faq.a: Content writing informs and attracts readers, for example with blog posts. Sales copy asks for an action, such as buying, booking or signing up. Many writers do both, but the skills and samples differ.

faq.q: What should the copywriter know about my customers?
faq.a: As much as possible: who they are, the problem they want solved, what they have tried before, and what stops them buying. Real customer reviews, emails and support questions are the best source.

faq.q: Can the copywriter make claims about results?
faq.a: Only claims you can prove. Health, income and financial claims are especially risky and may be regulated. Check the rules that apply to your product and market.

faq.q: How long should a sales page be?
faq.a: As long as it takes to answer the buyer's questions. Simple, low-price products need less; complex or expensive ones often need more explanation and proof.
